usedFor: Google Meet holds your calls and HubSpot holds your pipeline, so “New Upcoming Meeting” can run “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Upcoming Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A call on the calendar opens a deal before it starts, so the sales conversation has a record.

watchOut: “New Upcoming Meeting” runs for any calendar event with a Meet link, so internal calls will also reach “Create Deal”.
